summary.text: Unlimited Wind is Wu Yong's immortal killer move. A dark green wind grows into a huge tornado pillar, and each use expends ten thousand of his wind path dao marks.

claims.text: Near Infallible blessed land, Wu Yong places his concentration on the immortal killer move Unlimited Wind as Southern Border’s Gu Immortals strike Heavenly Court’s super immortal formation. The wind charges with a thunderous roar, uprooting trees and sending rocks flying. The formation’s halo is eroded and makes creaking sounds; methods that try to weaken Unlimited Wind show little effect. Wu Yong says he has never used this move easily: after paying the dao mark price the wind is long lasting and can only be resisted by specific techniques. This is the first time he uses it. Heavenly Court and even Southern Border’s Gu Immortals are shocked; it is his trump card. A hole opens in the formation and he orders the immortals to charge in with him.

Chi Qu You points out a loophole in Heavenly Court’s spaceless formation and tells Wu Yong to link with the Unlimited Wind outside to break the formation from there. Wu Yong detects the wind through the loophole, and wild winds break the formation.

Myriad Ghost Sword Dragon has the same weakness and price: it expends the Gu Immortal’s dao marks permanently. Unlimited Wind uses ten thousand dao marks each time, while that move uses four thousand soul path dao marks per use. When Fang Yuan reaches the Infallible blessed land battlefield, the giant tornado that supports heaven and earth is the thing that attracts his attention the most.

Wind Sweeping Building enters the Unlimited Wind reaching toward the sky instead of aiding Qing Ye or Li Huang. The current Wind Sweeping Building Lord laughs that given time he can make this wind his own. Due to that interference, Unlimited Wind starts to weaken again.

At Hairy Foot Mountain, Wu Yong has repeatedly tried to use Unlimited Wind, but Heavenly Court obstructs him and he cannot gain the time needed to unleash it. He still has the move, yet Heavenly Court does not let him use it. His special move Farewell Friend Wind also cannot be used: Heavenly Court’s Gu Immortals had been sleeping in the immortal graveyard, so he has no opportunity to become friends with them.

While Heavenly Court’s main forces retreat, Wu Yong finds a chance and permanently expends wind path dao marks to unleash the unceasing tornado. It rampages and suppresses the nine-nine consecutive unceasing formation from the outside.
Wu Yong lost a lot of his wind path dao marks during the fate war from using Unlimited Wind, and his foundation fell.
